title: Fire · Three levels of flame, and effects on fighters
description: effects.fire (src/effects.ts, src/flames.ts) and the fight particles simulated on the GPU (src/fight-particles.ts, docs/graphics.md): fire drawn whole by a shader at its three levels at night and by day, each up close, one fire changing level and dying down. Then a fight, captured at twice the pixels (run it with --gpu --scale 2): three dogs burning at the three levels (`game.ignite`), the flames crawling and swirling over their own bodies while GPU flame tongues, embers and smoke lick off their surfaces; fire hits at three strengths that suck embers in and set the dog alight; GPU sparks fired at a dog and embers dropped on the dogs, meeting their real shapes; a real Atacar on a burning dog; and a blow frozen in time drawn inside the dog (before) and in front of it (after). Clips run on the game's own clock at 30 fps.

steps.eval: window.bench = (levels, o = {}) => { const { height = 3, gap = 1.6, hide = true, start = 0, lift = .3 } = o; const g = window.gerard.game, app = g.app, e = g.effects; (window.fires ?? []).forEach(f => f.stop()); e.clear(); const me = app.root.findByName('Jugador'); const p = me.getPosition().clone(); me.enabled = !hide; document.querySelector('#hud').style.visibility = 'hidden'; const n = levels.length; const along = i => (start ? start + i * gap : (i - (n - 1) / 2) * gap) / Math.SQRT2; window.fires = levels.map((level, i) => { const x = p.x + along(i), z = p.z - along(i); return e.fire(p.clone().set(x, e.particles.groundAt(x, z), z), level); }); const mid = (along(0) + along(n - 1)) / 2 * (start ? 1 : 0); g.frame({ x: p.x + mid, y: p.y + height * lift, z: p.z - mid }, height); }

steps.caption: The three fires at night in the patio, from left to right: light (a small flicker), medium (a campfire), high (a blaze); each lights the floor around it
The three levels burning side by side
Light: a few ankle-high tongues, a white-hot bed, a thread of smoke and the odd spark
Medium: a knee-high campfire, licks breaking off its tips, sparks and grey smoke; it crackles now and then
High: a blaze taller than a person, flaring as it crackles, spitting sparks into a column of smoke

steps.each: const f = window.fires[0]; f.level = frameTime < 1.5 ? 'light' : frameTime < 3 ? 'medium' : 'high'; if (frameTime >= 4.6) f.stop();
steps.caption: One fire changing level while it burns: it kindles as light, grows to medium at 1.5 s and high at 3 s, then dies down at 4.6 s

steps.eval: window.fight = (() => { const g = window.gerard.game, app = g.app, root = app.root.findByName('Escenario de combate'); const ids = () => g.fighterIds(); const model = id => root.children.find(c => c.enabled && ids().some(f => f.id === id) && c === root.children.filter(e => e.enabled && !['Objetivo', 'Marca de tinta', 'Sello No-ta'].includes(e.name))[ids().findIndex(f => f.id === id)]); const at = (e, y = 0) => { const p = e.getPosition(); return { x: p.x, y: p.y + y, z: p.z }; }; return { g, app, ids, model, at, foes: () => ids().filter(f => !f.party).map(f => f.id), allies: () => ids().filter(f => f.party).map(f => f.id), hud(on) { document.querySelector('#battle').style.visibility = on ? '' : 'hidden'; if (on) document.querySelector('.command-trigger')?.focus(); }, out() { ids().forEach(f => g.ignite(f.id)); g.effects.clear(); }, hit(strength) { this.out(); const foe = this.model(this.foes()[0]), ally = this.model(this.allies()[0]); g.effects.element('fire', at(foe, .5), { from: at(ally, .5), feet: at(foe), strength, model: foe }); }, freeze(play, frames) { app.timeScale = 0; g.effects.clear(); play(g.effects, this.model(this.allies()[0]), this.model(this.foes()[1]), at); for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) app.fire('update', 1 / 60); } }; })(); fight.hud(false);
const [a, b, c] = fight.foes(); fight.g.ignite(a, 'light'); fight.g.ignite(b, 'medium'); fight.g.ignite(c, 'high');

The same three dogs burning, light, medium and high, sniffing and breathing while the fire moves with them
A weak fire hit (strength 0.6): the dog's own body catches lightly
A normal fire hit (strength 1): a medium fire on and around the dog
A strong fire hit (strength 1.6): the dog engulfed, then the fire dies down off it

steps.eval: fight.hud(false); fight.out(); { const g = window.gerard.game, foe = fight.model(fight.foes()[1]), p = foe.getPosition(); window.shoot = () => g.effects.gpu?.burst('spark', { at: { x: p.x - 1.2, y: p.y + .45, z: p.z }, count: 300, spread: .03, velocity: { x: 7, y: .6, z: 0 }, speed: .4, cone: .12, life: [1.2, 1.6] }); window.rain = () => g.effects.gpu?.burst('ember', { at: { x: p.x, y: p.y + 1.6, z: p.z }, count: 200, spread: .25, velocity: { x: 0, y: -2, z: 0 }, speed: .3, cone: .3, life: [2.5, 3] }); shoot(); }

steps.caption: GPU sparks fired at a dog's flank: they glance off its real shape (every part is a box), skid along it and some cling a moment; the low ones pass between its legs
Embers dropped on the dogs land on their backs and heads, spread along them, cling, and lift off again on the heat
A real Atacar on a burning dog, played through: the fire goes with the dog as it is struck and squashed, the blow's flash and sparks show over it
